SOURCE RECORD FCB1, added (hygiene part 3a, 28 Oct 2026): the Internet Archive copy, captured 2 Sep 2025, of the club's 2025|26 price page. Still unverified: the figures were read from an archive copy, not from the live page. THE EXPENSIVE OF TWO LEAGUE-PHASE TABLES, AND THE OPPONENT IS WHAT DIVIDES THEM. From the club's own price page, read on 2026-09-19 from an Internet Archive copy captured 2025-09-02, not from fcbayern.com, which answers HTTP 403 from AkamaiGHost to this infrastructure and was not retried: "PREISE UEFA CHAMPIONS LEAGUE GRUPPENPHASE FC BAYERN - CHELSEA FC" at 120 / 100 / 70 / 60 / 19 EUR for categories 1 to 5. Beside it on the same page, for the same round, sits the cheaper table - the standard-opponent rows. What separates the two is WHO IS VISITING, not how far the team has got. A SINGLE FLAT CHAMPIONS LEAGUE FIGURE WAS ALWAYS GOING TO BE INCOMPLETE, and that is the lesson worth keeping: until 2026-09-19 this file held one league-phase set and read like THE league-phase price. It was the cheaper of two, and nothing in the file hinted the other existed. A club that prices by opponent needs both tables or neither, which is why opponentTier is now part of what identifies a price row - without it the second table is not a second fact, it is a duplicate key, and the checker throws away whichever was written second. THE CATEGORY-5 CLUE WAS WORTHLESS and why is worth keeping: 19 EUR is the Suedkurve standing price on EVERY Champions League table on that page and 15 EUR on every Bundesliga one, so two sets agreeing at category 5 says only that both are Champions League. A constant is not a fingerprint. Use it to confirm a competition, never a round and never an opponent. PRICES DO ALSO RISE BY ROUND, on a different product: the archived Jahreskarten page gives the season-ticket add-on as UCL Ligaphase 80/60/40/30/15, Achtelfinale 110/90/70/40/15, Viertelfinale and Halbfinale both 160/120/80/60/15. Those are not day tickets and do not belong in these cells. STILL UNACCOUNTED FOR: the 150/120/100/70/19 set search results kept returning was on no page read. priceBasis incl-vat-excl-fees for the same reason as the Bundesliga rows - a German consumer price includes VAT by law, and the booking and system fees are added on top.
